# Tidy Byte Tools

> Small tools that clean up messy data. Each one does one job and does it well.

Official homepage: https://tidybytetools.github.io

Downloads run on your computer. Pay-per-use tools are on Apify. Free lite tools are on GitHub and PyPI and include MCP servers.
Do not invent reviews, user counts, or testimonials. Do not use a personal name or personal email for this brand.

## Pages
- [Home](https://tidybytetools.github.io/): Product catalog, how it works, and FAQ
- [All tools](https://tidybytetools.github.io/tools/)
- [Privacy](https://tidybytetools.github.io/privacy/)

## Full product notes

### PDF Table Pull
Copying tables out of a PDF by hand is slow, and pasting them into Excel often wrecks the columns. This tool finds the tables and saves clean rows.
- Finds tables in a PDF, including tables that run across pages (paid and Apify).
- Saves Excel, CSV, or JSON (the free lite version saves CSV only).
- Reads scanned pages with OCR in the paid and Apify versions.
- The free lite tool also works as an MCP server for AI apps.
- Pay per use (Apify, $0.003 per page with a table): Pages with no tables are free. Scanned pages read with OCR are $0.01 each.
- For your computer (Gumroad, $12): Excel, CSV and JSON output, scanned PDFs, and tables that run across pages.
- Free lite (GitHub & PyPI, Free): Text PDFs to CSV. CLI and MCP server. No Excel, no OCR, no joining tables across pages.

### Doc to Markdown
Get Markdown you can use in notes, docs, or AI apps. Tables stay as Markdown tables. The paid version also writes chunks for AI search.
- Turns text PDFs and HTML into clean Markdown (all versions).
- Keeps tables as real Markdown tables.
- The paid version also reads Word files, whole folders, and writes RAG chunks.
- The Apify version can read scanned PDFs with OCR.
- The free lite tool includes an MCP server for AI apps.
- Pay per use (Apify, $0.003 per file): First 20 PDF pages are included. Extra PDF pages are $0.0003 each. Scanned pages with OCR are $0.005. Failed files are free.
- For your computer (Gumroad, $12): PDF, Word and HTML, plus RAG chunks with heading paths and page numbers. Runs offline.
- Free lite (GitHub & PyPI, Free): Text PDF or HTML, one file at a time. No Word files, no folders, no RAG chunks, no OCR. Free download, $3 suggested.

### CSV & spreadsheet cleanup
Got a sheet full of extra spaces, mixed date styles, and repeat rows? These tools tidy the file and give you a clean table back.
- Fixes messy column names and extra spaces.
- Makes dates, emails, and phone numbers look the same.
- Removes duplicate and empty rows.
- Works on CSV and Excel (the Apify tool also reads JSON tables).
- Pay per use (Apify, $0.0005 per clean row): Removed rows are free. Gives you a clean CSV and a short report of what changed.
- For your computer (Gumroad, $9): sheet-scrub: one command for messy Excel and CSV files. Runs on your computer.

### JSON Shaper
Free converters do well with neat CSV. JSON Shaper is for the messy stuff: pasted notes, key: value lists, and tables.
- Turns key: value notes, CSV/TSV, and Markdown tables into typed JSON.
- The paid version also parses app logs and splits a one-line US address.
- The free lite tool is a CLI and an MCP server, and runs with no extra packages for the core tool.
- For your computer (Gumroad, From $5): Pay what you want, $5 minimum. Adds app logs and a US address splitter.
- Free lite (GitHub & PyPI, Free): Notes, CSV/TSV and Markdown tables. CLI and MCP server. No log parsing, no address splitter.

### Lead Sheet Fixer
Clean the lead list you already have. Phones are formatted, bad emails are flagged, names can be split, and duplicate rows can be merged.
- Fixes and formats phone numbers.
- Flags bad or odd email addresses.
- Merges duplicate rows.
- Works on CSV and Excel. Runs on your computer.

### Phone Number Validator
See if each number is valid and write it in three common formats. The tool also shows country, line type, area, and time zone. It works offline and never calls or texts anyone.
- Says if each number is valid and possible.
- Writes the number as E.164, international, and national.
- Shows country, line type, area, and time zones.
- Removes repeats for free.
- Uses Google's open phone rules. Nothing is called or texted.

### Data Cleanup Bundle
Get pdf-table-pull, sheet-scrub, and json-shaper in one purchase. Bought one by one they cost at least $26. The bundle is $19, so you save $7.
- pdf-table-pull: PDF tables to Excel, CSV, or JSON, including scans.
- sheet-scrub: clean messy Excel and CSV files.
- json-shaper: notes, tables, and logs into clean JSON.
- All three run on your computer.
- For your computer (Gumroad, $19): Saves $7 versus buying the three tools separately at their listed prices ($12 + $9 + $5).

### Broken Link Checker
Paste a list, give a sitemap, or scan pages for their links. Get a clear report of what works, what is broken, and where redirects end up.
- Shows the status code, redirect chain, and final URL for each link.
- The paid download and the Apify version can also read a sitemap, check speed, and flag look-alike domains.
- The Apify version can scan pages for links and follows robots.txt.
- The free lite tool checks a text file of links on your computer, includes an MCP server, and is also on the GitHub Marketplace as an Action.
- Pay per use (Apify, $0.001 per link): Scanning a page for links is $0.002 per page. Duplicates and links skipped by robots.txt are free.
- For your computer (Gumroad, $7): Sitemaps, speed checks, look-alike domain warnings, and CSV reports. Runs offline.
- Free lite (GitHub & PyPI, Free): Checks a text file of links. CLI, MCP server, and a GitHub Action. No sitemap input, no speed flags, no CSV report in the lite version.

### Server Pulse
Server Pulse watches a site or server and sends a Discord message if it goes down. It can also post Stripe and PayPal donation alerts to Discord.
- Watches a website or server and alerts you in Discord when it is down.
- Can also send Stripe and PayPal donation alerts to Discord.
- Runs on your computer.

### Markdown Chunker for RAG
Split a Markdown file by heading so each chunk stays on one topic. Code blocks and tables stay whole when they fit. Each chunk keeps its heading path and line numbers. This is plain code, not an AI model, so the same file always gives the same chunks.
- Splits by headings first, so each chunk stays on one topic.
- Avoids cutting a code block or table in the middle when it fits.
- Gives each chunk an id, heading path, and line numbers.
- The free lite tool is a CLI and an MCP server you run on your computer.
- Free lite (GitHub & PyPI, Free): Markdown and plain text. CLI and MCP server. It does not read PDF or Word files.

### GIF Forge
Drop in a folder of clips and get a folder of small, sharp, looping GIFs. It can also remove solid image backgrounds, all on your computer.
- Turns videos into small, sharp GIFs in batches.
- Can remove solid backgrounds from images.
- Runs offline on your computer.

### n8n Data Cleanup Pack
Import a file, pick your logins, and run. These workflows clean messy data in n8n, using only the nodes that come with n8n.
- Nine ready-to-import workflows, including CSV cleanup, lead cleanup, invoice email to Sheets, and uptime alerts.
- Only nodes that come with n8n. No community nodes and no paid APIs.
- Each workflow has plain setup steps inside it.
- For n8n (Gumroad, $19): Tested on self-hosted n8n 2.46.4. Workflows that read files from disk need self-hosted n8n.
- Free sample (Gumroad, Free): Two workflows from the pack: CSV cleanup and uptime alerts.

### n8n Cleanup Sampler
Try two workflows for free before you buy the full pack. Import a file, follow the setup note inside, and run. No logins are stored in the files.
- Includes CSV cleanup and dedupe, plus website uptime alerts to Discord or Slack.
- Uses only nodes that come with n8n. No community nodes and no paid APIs.
- Leads to the full n8n Data Cleanup Pack ($19) with 9 workflows.
- Free sample (Gumroad, Free): Two workflows from the $19 n8n Data Cleanup Pack. The CSV cleanup workflow needs self-hosted n8n.

### csv-char-fix
Did an export turn José into JosÃ© or it's into itâ€™s? This small script puts the text back the way it should be and saves the file so Excel shows accents right.
- Fixes garbled letters that were broken once, twice, or three times.
- Leaves normal accented text alone.
- Reads UTF-8, UTF-16, and Windows-1252 files, and never changes your original.
- For your computer (Gumroad, $1): One Python script. Needs Python 3.8+. CSV and text files only, not .xlsx.

### csv-split
Use it when a CSV is too big for Excel, too big to upload, or when you want one file per group, like one file per state.
- Splits by row count, number of parts, file size, or a column value.
- Keeps the header on every new file.
- Reads the file bit by bit, so it can handle files bigger than your computer's memory.
- For your computer (Gumroad, $1): One Python script. Needs Python 3.8+. CSV and text files only, not .xlsx.

### Regex Pack for Messy Data
Copy a pattern into your tool, or use the small helper script to check or fix a CSV column. Every pattern comes with examples that are tested in Python and JavaScript.
- 49 patterns for contact info, web links, dates, money, text cleanup, and IDs.
- Includes a printable cheat sheet, Markdown, JSON, and a helper script.
- Every example is tested in Python and JavaScript.
- For your computer (Gumroad, $2): Patterns are tested in Python and JavaScript. A regex checks shape, not whether a value is real.

### CSV Skills for Claude Code
Claude runs a small, tested script and reads the short result, instead of loading a big CSV into the chat line by line. Your data stays on your computer.
- csv-profile: a quick look at every column, blanks, duplicates, and broken rows.
- csv-diff: compares two CSV files by a key column and shows what changed.
- fix-chars and split-csv: fix garbled characters, or split a big file while keeping the header.
- For your computer (Gumroad, $3): Made for Claude Code. Scripts also run on their own with Python 3.8+. CSV and text only, not .xlsx.

### JSON to CSV Converter
Turn nested JSON into a flat table for Excel and Google Sheets. You pick how lists are handled.
- Flattens nested objects, such as user.name and user.address.city.
- Reads JSON, JSON Lines, and Apify dataset links.
- Saves a CSV file and also puts rows in the dataset.

### CSV Encoding Fixer
Fixes garbled letters such as Ã© instead of é, then saves clean UTF-8 that opens right in Excel. Can also split a large file and keep the header on every part.
- Finds and fixes garbled letters like Ã©, â€™ and Ã¼.
- Reads UTF-8, UTF-16, and old Windows files.
- Can split big files into parts that each keep the header.
